Third-party libraries used by the "사진 보정" (photo fix) menu. They are loaded only when that menu is used.

libraw/    libraw-wasm 1.6.0 (npm) - RAW decoder. Wrapper: ISC. LibRaw itself: LGPL 2.1 / CDDL 1.0. https://github.com/ybouane/LibRaw-Wasm
faceapi/   @vladmandic/face-api 1.7.15 (npm) - face detection (SSD MobileNet v1 model). MIT. https://github.com/vladmandic/face-api
facemesh/  @mediapipe/face_mesh 0.4.1633559619 (npm) - eyelid landmarks. Apache 2.0. https://github.com/google/mediapipe
